capabilities: set a per-note view mode with a prefer-view frontmatter property
support read, edit, edit-source, and edit-preview values
apply the view mode automatically when a note is opened
extras: README is short: it explains the property, its four values, and shows examples, but documents no settings or troubleshooting.
problem: Obsidian uses one view mode at a time, so notes that are better read or edited in a specific mode must be switched manually every time they are opened.
summary: Frontmatter-based plugin that sets a note's view mode (read or edit) via a prefer-view property in the note itself.
